ms.promise:
Bring’s wallet-side application comprising of:
・Chrome extension code for the partner wallet 
・All UIs 
・Tokens cache for ADA 
・Backend support for all the above (APIs)
・Functionalities of Chrome extension:

Popup part:
Get a domain list from our API, cache it locally, and update the domain list every 48 hours.
Check every domain that the user goes to if the domain is included in the domain list.
Integrate with the extension and get the relevant wallet address.
Open a popup that offers cashback for relevant domains.
Opt-out - turn off popups for various time frames.
Activate a deal - Register the deal using the specific wallet address.
Redirect to the relevant URL for the deal.
Check if the user has any new rewards and open a popup with details about the update and where he can see more details.
Custom themes - allowing the outlets that are using our extension to customize the theme of the popup.
Retailers part:
Display a list of all retailers available and relevant to the user’s country.
Have the ability to filter the retailer's list by category or by search.
Activate a deal for a specific retailer and get cashback for this purchase.
Show the total tokens the user gained by buying

Clarification:
'Tokens cash' is not to be referred to as a feature to showcase. We use this term as a way to describe the rewards that the user has before claiming the cashbach. The 'Tokens cash' functionality is the locking mechanism we have during the time period a user can still return the product which differs from different sellers and different products. As long as the product is still refundable or can be replaced, the ADA cashback remains locked, and the UI presented as pending (count down), reduced, cancelled or claimed. In the transaction history it shows when it is eligible to claim once the lock period is done.
